name: export-spo-access-request-settings
title: Export SharePoint Access Request Settings
shortDescription: Audit SharePoint Online access request settings across site collections and subsites.
longDescription: Audit SharePoint Online access request settings across all site collections and subsites, including whether requests are enabled, disabled, inherited, or configured for an email address or Owners group.
